question: Which Indian dancer won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Manipuri Dance in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akham Lakshmi Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Akham Lakshmi Devi** is a renowned Indian dancer known for her expertise in Manipuri dance.
 
• She was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 2018 for her significant contribution to Manipuri dance.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is one of the highest Indian recognitions given to practicing artists.
 
• Her dedication and excellence in the art form have earned her national and international recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**

 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, also known as the Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar, is an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India’s National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• It is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists, gurus, and scholars in the field of performing arts.
 
• The award was established in 1952 and is given annually to artists in the field of music, dance, and drama.
 
• Recipients of the award receive a purse of Rs. 1,00,000, a shawl, and a tamrapatra (a brass plaque).
 
 
 
• **Manipuri Dance**
 
 
• Manipuri dance is one of the major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the northeastern state of Manipur.
 
• It is known for its graceful and fluid movements, which are usually performed to the accompaniment of traditional Manipuri music.
 
• Manipuri dance has a strong connection with the traditions and rituals of the people of Manipur, and it is often performed during religious and cultural festivals.
 
• The dance form includes various styles such as Ras Leela, Pung Cholom, and Thang Ta, among others.
 
 
 
• **Other notable awardees in 2018**
 
 
• Dr. Aruna Mohanty: She received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her contributions to Odissi dance.
 
• Gopika Varma: She is known for her contributions to Mohiniyattam dance.
 
• Surupa Sen: She received the award for her contributions to contemporary dance.
